title: Pressure-Fed Monopropellant Attitude Thruster
description: Spacecraft pressure-fed monopropellant reaction-control thruster connecting a nitrogen-pressurized propellant tank through a solenoid thrust valve to a catalytic decomposition chamber and bell nozzle.
code:
DECK: MonoProp_RCS_Thruster
TITLE: "Pressure-Fed Monopropellant Reaction Control Thruster"

COMPONENTS:
  PROP_TANK TYPE=TANK TITLE="Pressurized Propellant Tank" X=100 Y=200
    PARAMS: P_OUT=2.4E6, T_OUT=295.0, FLUID=MMH

  PRESS_GAS TYPE=TANK TITLE="Helium Pressurant Tank" X=100 Y=80
    PARAMS: P_OUT=2.6E6, T_OUT=295.0, FLUID=HELIUM

  THRUST_VALVE TYPE=VALVE TITLE="Solenoid Thrust Valve" X=320 Y=200
    PARAMS: CV=0.00045, POSITION=1.0, FLUID=MMH

  CHAMBER TYPE=CHAMBER TITLE="Catalytic Decomposition Chamber" X=560 Y=200
    PARAMS: PC=1.5E6, PA=1.0E3, MR=1.0, AT=0.00018, EPS=40.0, VC=0.0004
    S0: PC=1.5E6

CONNECTIONS:
  PROP_TANK.OUTLET -> THRUST_VALVE.INLET
  THRUST_VALVE.OUTLET -> CHAMBER.INJ_FUEL
  PRESS_GAS.OUTLET -> CHAMBER.INJ_OX

title: Pressure-Fed Hypergolic Orbital Maneuvering Engine
description: Bipropellant NTO/MMH pressure-fed Orbital Maneuvering System (OMS) rocket engine with separate oxidizer and fuel tanks, isolation valves, and a regeneratively cooled combustion chamber.
code:
DECK: OMS_Hypergolic_Engine
TITLE: "Pressure-Fed NTO/MMH Orbital Maneuvering System Engine"

COMPONENTS:
  OX_TANK TYPE=TANK TITLE="NTO Oxidizer Tank" X=80 Y=120
    PARAMS: P_OUT=1.9E6, T_OUT=295.0, FLUID=NTO

  FUEL_TANK TYPE=TANK TITLE="MMH Fuel Tank" X=80 Y=280
    PARAMS: P_OUT=1.9E6, T_OUT=295.0, FLUID=MMH

  OX_VALVE TYPE=VALVE TITLE="Main Oxidizer Bipropellant Valve" X=300 Y=120
    PARAMS: CV=0.0022, POSITION=1.0, FLUID=NTO

  FUEL_VALVE TYPE=VALVE TITLE="Main Fuel Bipropellant Valve" X=300 Y=280
    PARAMS: CV=0.0018, POSITION=1.0, FLUID=MMH

  CHAMBER TYPE=CHAMBER TITLE="OMS Main Combustion Chamber" X=560 Y=200
    PARAMS: PC=0.86E6, PA=1.0E3, MR=1.65, AT=0.0185, EPS=55.0, VC=0.022
    S0: PC=0.86E6

CONNECTIONS:
  OX_TANK.OUTLET -> OX_VALVE.INLET
  FUEL_TANK.OUTLET -> FUEL_VALVE.INLET
  OX_VALVE.OUTLET -> CHAMBER.INJ_OX
  FUEL_VALVE.OUTLET -> CHAMBER.INJ_FUEL

title: Gas-Generator Cycle LOX/RP-1 Booster Engine
description: Merlin-class open-cycle LOX/RP-1 liquid booster rocket engine with single-shaft dual-impeller turbopump, fuel-rich gas generator, turbine drive, main valves, and regeneratively cooled thrust chamber.
code:
DECK: GasGenerator_LOX_RP1_Booster
TITLE: "Open-Cycle Gas-Generator LOX/RP-1 Booster Engine"

COMPONENTS:
  LOX_TANK TYPE=TANK TITLE="LOX Main Tank" X=60 Y=100
    PARAMS: P_OUT=0.35E6, T_OUT=90.0, FLUID=LOX

  RP1_TANK TYPE=TANK TITLE="RP-1 Kerosene Tank" X=60 Y=300
    PARAMS: P_OUT=0.35E6, T_OUT=290.0, FLUID=RP1

  OX_PUMP TYPE=PUMP TITLE="LOX Centrifugal Pump" X=240 Y=100
    PARAMS: DELTA_P=12.5E6, ETA=0.76, RHO=1140.0, P_IN=0.35E6, P_VAP=0.10E6, NPSH_R=0.08E6, FLUID=LOX

  FUEL_PUMP TYPE=PUMP TITLE="RP-1 Centrifugal Pump" X=240 Y=300
    PARAMS: DELTA_P=14.2E6, ETA=0.75, RHO=810.0, P_IN=0.35E6, P_VAP=0.01E6, NPSH_R=0.08E6, FLUID=RP1

  GG_CHAMBER TYPE=CHAMBER TITLE="Fuel-Rich Gas Generator" X=420 Y=420
    PARAMS: PC=7.5E6, PA=0.101E6, MR=0.35, AT=0.006, EPS=1.0, VC=0.005
    S0: PC=7.5E6

  GG_TURBINE TYPE=TURBINE TITLE="Impulse Drive Turbine" X=560 Y=420
    PARAMS: PR=4.2, ETA=0.68, T_IN=920.0, FLUID=COMBUSTION_GAS

  TP_SHAFT TYPE=SHAFT TITLE="Single-Shaft Turbopump" X=390 Y=200
    PARAMS: INERTIA=0.085, SPEED_RPM=32000.0, MAX_RPM=40000.0
    S0: SPEED_RPM=32000.0

  MAIN_OX_VALVE TYPE=VALVE TITLE="Main LOX Valve" X=460 Y=100
    PARAMS: CV=0.0085, POSITION=1.0, FLUID=LOX

  MAIN_FUEL_VALVE TYPE=VALVE TITLE="Main RP-1 Valve" X=460 Y=300
    PARAMS: CV=0.0055, POSITION=1.0, FLUID=RP1

  MAIN_CHAMBER TYPE=CHAMBER TITLE="Main Thrust Chamber" X=700 Y=200
    PARAMS: PC=9.7E6, PA=0.101E6, MR=2.36, AT=0.048, EPS=16.0, VC=0.038
    S0: PC=9.7E6

CONNECTIONS:
  LOX_TANK.OUTLET -> OX_PUMP.INLET
  RP1_TANK.OUTLET -> FUEL_PUMP.INLET
  OX_PUMP.OUTLET -> MAIN_OX_VALVE.INLET
  FUEL_PUMP.OUTLET -> MAIN_FUEL_VALVE.INLET
  OX_PUMP.OUTLET -> GG_CHAMBER.INJ_OX
  FUEL_PUMP.OUTLET -> GG_CHAMBER.INJ_FUEL
  GG_CHAMBER.NOZZLE_OUT -> GG_TURBINE.INLET
  MAIN_OX_VALVE.OUTLET -> MAIN_CHAMBER.INJ_OX
  MAIN_FUEL_VALVE.OUTLET -> MAIN_CHAMBER.INJ_FUEL
  GG_TURBINE.SHAFT_OUT -> TP_SHAFT.TURBINE_POWER
  TP_SHAFT.PUMP_POWER -> OX_PUMP.SHAFT_IN
  TP_SHAFT.PUMP_POWER -> FUEL_PUMP.SHAFT_IN

title: Expander-Cycle LOX/LH2 Upper-Stage Engine
description: RL10-class closed expander-cycle cryogenic LOX/LH2 upper-stage rocket engine where heated hydrogen from the regenerative cooling jacket drives the turbopump turbine before entering the main injector.
code:
DECK: ExpanderCycle_RL10_UpperStage
TITLE: "Closed Expander-Cycle LOX/LH2 Upper-Stage Engine"

COMPONENTS:
  LOX_TANK TYPE=TANK TITLE="Cryogenic LOX Tank" X=60 Y=100
    PARAMS: P_OUT=0.28E6, T_OUT=90.0, FLUID=LOX

  LH2_TANK TYPE=TANK TITLE="Cryogenic LH2 Tank" X=60 Y=320
    PARAMS: P_OUT=0.22E6, T_OUT=20.4, FLUID=LH2

  LOX_PUMP TYPE=PUMP TITLE="LOX Boost/Main Pump" X=240 Y=100
    PARAMS: DELTA_P=5.8E6, ETA=0.74, RHO=1140.0, P_IN=0.28E6, P_VAP=0.10E6, NPSH_R=0.06E6, FLUID=LOX

  LH2_PUMP TYPE=PUMP TITLE="Two-Stage LH2 Pump" X=240 Y=320
    PARAMS: DELTA_P=8.4E6, ETA=0.72, RHO=71.0, P_IN=0.22E6, P_VAP=0.08E6, NPSH_R=0.05E6, FLUID=LH2

  COOL_VALVE TYPE=VALVE TITLE="Regenerative Jacket Control Valve" X=420 Y=320
    PARAMS: CV=0.0042, POSITION=0.92, FLUID=LH2

  EXP_TURBINE TYPE=TURBINE TITLE="Gaseous Hydrogen Expander Turbine" X=580 Y=320
    PARAMS: PR=1.55, ETA=0.78, T_IN=225.0, FLUID=LH2

  OX_CTRL_VALVE TYPE=VALVE TITLE="Main Oxidizer Control Valve" X=440 Y=100
    PARAMS: CV=0.0048, POSITION=0.95, FLUID=LOX

  GEAR_SHAFT TYPE=SHAFT TITLE="Geared Turbopump Shaft" X=400 Y=200
    PARAMS: INERTIA=0.045, SPEED_RPM=30500.0, MAX_RPM=38000.0
    S0: SPEED_RPM=30500.0

  CHAMBER TYPE=CHAMBER TITLE="Regeneratively Cooled Vacuum Chamber" X=760 Y=200
    PARAMS: PC=4.4E6, PA=1.0E3, MR=5.88, AT=0.0155, EPS=84.0, VC=0.019
    S0: PC=4.4E6

CONNECTIONS:
  LOX_TANK.OUTLET -> LOX_PUMP.INLET
  LH2_TANK.OUTLET -> LH2_PUMP.INLET
  LOX_PUMP.OUTLET -> OX_CTRL_VALVE.INLET
  OX_CTRL_VALVE.OUTLET -> CHAMBER.INJ_OX
  LH2_PUMP.OUTLET -> COOL_VALVE.INLET
  COOL_VALVE.OUTLET -> EXP_TURBINE.INLET
  EXP_TURBINE.OUTLET -> CHAMBER.INJ_FUEL
  EXP_TURBINE.SHAFT_OUT -> GEAR_SHAFT.TURBINE_POWER
  GEAR_SHAFT.PUMP_POWER -> LOX_PUMP.SHAFT_IN
  GEAR_SHAFT.PUMP_POWER -> LH2_PUMP.SHAFT_IN

title: Full-Flow Staged-Combustion LOX/CH4 Engine Startup
description: High-chamber-pressure Full-Flow Staged-Combustion (FFSC) methalox rocket engine with dual oxidizer-rich and fuel-rich preburners, twin independent turbopumps, and a companion transient startup valve schedule.
code:
DECK: FFSC_LOX_LCH4_Engine
TITLE: "Full-Flow Staged-Combustion LOX/LCH4 Methalox Engine"

COMPONENTS:
  LOX_TANK TYPE=TANK TITLE="Subcooled LOX Tank" X=50 Y=100
    PARAMS: P_OUT=0.45E6, T_OUT=82.0, FLUID=LOX

  CH4_TANK TYPE=TANK TITLE="Subcooled LCH4 Tank" X=50 Y=380
    PARAMS: P_OUT=0.42E6, T_OUT=100.0, FLUID=LCH4

  OX_PUMP TYPE=PUMP TITLE="High-Pressure LOX Turbopump" X=220 Y=100
    PARAMS: DELTA_P=58.0E6, ETA=0.80, RHO=1180.0, P_IN=0.45E6, P_VAP=0.05E6, NPSH_R=0.10E6, FLUID=LOX

  CH4_PUMP TYPE=PUMP TITLE="High-Pressure LCH4 Turbopump" X=220 Y=380
    PARAMS: DELTA_P=62.0E6, ETA=0.79, RHO=440.0, P_IN=0.42E6, P_VAP=0.06E6, NPSH_R=0.10E6, FLUID=LCH4

  OX_VALVE TYPE=VALVE TITLE="Ox-Rich Preburner Throttle Valve" X=380 Y=100
    PARAMS: CV=0.0095, POSITION=0.95, FLUID=LOX

  CH4_VALVE TYPE=VALVE TITLE="Fuel-Rich Preburner Throttle Valve" X=380 Y=380
    PARAMS: CV=0.0072, POSITION=0.95, FLUID=LCH4

  OX_PREBURNER TYPE=CHAMBER TITLE="Oxidizer-Rich Preburner" X=540 Y=100
    PARAMS: PC=52.0E6, PA=25.0E6, MR=6.5, AT=0.025, EPS=1.0, VC=0.015
    S0: PC=52.0E6

  FUEL_PREBURNER TYPE=CHAMBER TITLE="Fuel-Rich Preburner" X=540 Y=380
    PARAMS: PC=52.0E6, PA=25.0E6, MR=0.85, AT=0.022, EPS=1.0, VC=0.014
    S0: PC=52.0E6

  OX_TURBINE TYPE=TURBINE TITLE="Ox-Rich Drive Turbine" X=700 Y=100
    PARAMS: PR=1.52, ETA=0.81, T_IN=780.0, FLUID=COMBUSTION_GAS

  FUEL_TURBINE TYPE=TURBINE TITLE="Fuel-Rich Drive Turbine" X=700 Y=380
    PARAMS: PR=1.52, ETA=0.80, T_IN=860.0, FLUID=COMBUSTION_GAS

  OX_SHAFT TYPE=SHAFT TITLE="LOX Turbopump Shaft" X=460 Y=190
    PARAMS: INERTIA=0.11, SPEED_RPM=28500.0, MAX_RPM=36000.0
    S0: SPEED_RPM=28500.0

  FUEL_SHAFT TYPE=SHAFT TITLE="LCH4 Turbopump Shaft" X=460 Y=290
    PARAMS: INERTIA=0.095, SPEED_RPM=34500.0, MAX_RPM=42000.0
    S0: SPEED_RPM=34500.0

  MAIN_CHAMBER TYPE=CHAMBER TITLE="300-bar FFSC Main Thrust Chamber" X=880 Y=240
    PARAMS: PC=30.0E6, PA=0.101E6, MR=3.55, AT=0.042, EPS=35.0, VC=0.048
    S0: PC=30.0E6

CONNECTIONS:
  LOX_TANK.OUTLET -> OX_PUMP.INLET
  CH4_TANK.OUTLET -> CH4_PUMP.INLET
  OX_PUMP.OUTLET -> OX_VALVE.INLET
  CH4_PUMP.OUTLET -> CH4_VALVE.INLET
  OX_VALVE.OUTLET -> OX_PREBURNER.INJ_OX
  CH4_VALVE.OUTLET -> OX_PREBURNER.INJ_FUEL
  OX_VALVE.OUTLET -> FUEL_PREBURNER.INJ_OX
  CH4_VALVE.OUTLET -> FUEL_PREBURNER.INJ_FUEL
  OX_PREBURNER.NOZZLE_OUT -> OX_TURBINE.INLET
  FUEL_PREBURNER.NOZZLE_OUT -> FUEL_TURBINE.INLET
  OX_TURBINE.OUTLET -> MAIN_CHAMBER.INJ_OX
  FUEL_TURBINE.OUTLET -> MAIN_CHAMBER.INJ_FUEL
  OX_TURBINE.SHAFT_OUT -> OX_SHAFT.TURBINE_POWER
  OX_SHAFT.PUMP_POWER -> OX_PUMP.SHAFT_IN
  FUEL_TURBINE.SHAFT_OUT -> FUEL_SHAFT.TURBINE_POWER
  FUEL_SHAFT.PUMP_POWER -> CH4_PUMP.SHAFT_IN
